title: Author milestone report contains handwritten provenance timestamps instead of raw event timestamps
evidence: report.md claims RED captured 00:15:30 and GREEN captured 00:23:45, both of which precede the parent rejection commit 942ef09 (00:43:09) and the worker fix dispatch event (~00:44). File mtime and parent event receipts confirm execution actually occurred between 00:46 and 00:54. The underlying 60/60 JUnit XML and test outputs are authentic and independently reproduced, but the prose timestamps are reconstructed rather than raw.
impact: Documentation provenance inaccuracy; does not impair runtime behavior or test validity.
